---
title: "Make PPP race imputation graphs"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggthemes)
library(tidyverse)
library(grafify)
library(patchwork)

.dir <- getwd()
while (!dir.exists(file.path(.dir, "Data")) && .dir != dirname(.dir)) {
  .dir <- dirname(.dir)
}
parent_dir <- .dir
plots_dir <- file.path(parent_dir, "Results", "Plots")
figs_dir <- file.path(plots_dir, "Figs")
dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

bw_clean <- function(base_size = 16) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
      axis.title = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
      legend.text = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
      legend.title = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
      strip.text = element_text(family = "Palatino"),
      legend.background = element_rect(color = NA),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
        color = "grey80",
        linetype = "dotted",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0)
    )
}

```

# F1

```{r f1_plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
f1_race_df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(plots_dir, "PPP_04_F1_race.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = White:Other, names_to = "race", values_to = "f1")

f1_race_plot <- f1_race_df %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Last Name", "ZIP", "BISG", "BIFSG", "ZRP", "NamePrism")),
    race = factor(race, levels = c("White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian", "Other")),
    f1 = f1 / 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = f1, fill = Method, color = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(~ race) +
  labs(x = "", y = "F1") +
  scale_fill_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_color_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  bw_clean()

f1_agg_df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(plots_dir, "PPP_05_F1_aggregated.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = Weighted:Macro, names_to = "weights", values_to = "f1")

f1_agg_plot <- f1_agg_df %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Last Name", "ZIP", "BISG", "BIFSG", "ZRP", "NamePrism")),
    weights = factor(weights, levels = c("Weighted", "Micro", "Macro")),
    f1 = f1 / 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = f1, fill = Method, color = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(~ weights) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Aggregated F1") +
  scale_fill_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_color_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  bw_clean()

f1_combined <- f1_race_plot / f1_agg_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))

ggsave(file.path(figs_dir, "PPP_04_F1_race.png"), f1_race_plot, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 200)
ggsave(file.path(figs_dir, "PPP_05_F1_aggregated.png"), f1_agg_plot, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 200)
ggsave(file.path(figs_dir, "PPP_F1s.png"), f1_combined, width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 200)
```

# Gaps

```{r gap_plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gap_df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(plots_dir, "PPP_07_all_gaps.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = Black_White:Asian_White,
    names_to = "gap",
    values_to = "diff"
  )

gap_method_levels <- c("Real", "Last Name", "ZIP", "BISG", "BIFSG", "ZRP", "NamePrism", "BIRDiE")
gap_axis_step <- 5
gap_axis_limits <- c(
  floor(min(gap_df$diff, na.rm = TRUE) / gap_axis_step) * gap_axis_step,
  ceiling(max(gap_df$diff, na.rm = TRUE) / gap_axis_step) * gap_axis_step
)

gap_plot <- gap_df %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = gap_method_levels),
    gap = factor(
      gap,
      levels = c(
        "Black_White", "Hispanic_White", "Asian_White",
        "Black_Hispanic", "Black_Asian", "Hispanic_Asian"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Black-White", "Hispanic-White", "Asian-White",
        "Black-Hispanic", "Black-Asian", "Hispanic-Asian"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = diff)) +
  geom_col(
    data = . %>% filter(Method != "Real"),
    aes(fill = Method, color = Method),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = . %>% filter(Method == "Real"),
    aes(yintercept = diff),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ gap) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Gap in Percentage Points") +
  scale_fill_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_color_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(gap_axis_limits[1], gap_axis_limits[2], gap_axis_step),
    limits = gap_axis_limits
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1), color = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  bw_clean() +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11, family = "Palatino"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, family = "Palatino"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(3, "pt")
  )

ggsave(file.path(figs_dir, "PPP_07_all_gaps.png"), gap_plot, width = 9.5, height = 5.2, dpi = 200)
```

# Population

```{r population_plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
population_df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(plots_dir, "PPP_08_population.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = White:Other, names_to = "race", values_to = "rate")

population_axis_step <- 10
population_axis_limits <- c(
  0,
  ceiling(max(population_df$rate, na.rm = TRUE) / population_axis_step) * population_axis_step
)

population_plot <- population_df %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Real", "Last Name", "ZIP", "BISG", "BIFSG", "ZRP", "NamePrism")),
    race = factor(race, levels = c("White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian", "Other"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = rate)) +
  geom_col(
    data = . %>% filter(Method != "Real"),
    aes(fill = Method, color = Method),
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = . %>% filter(Method == "Real"),
    aes(yintercept = rate),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ race) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Percent of the Population (%)") +
  scale_fill_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_color_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(population_axis_limits[1], population_axis_limits[2], population_axis_step),
    limits = population_axis_limits
  ) +
  bw_clean()

distance_plot <- population_df %>%
  select(Method, Distance) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Last Name", "ZIP", "BISG", "BIFSG", "ZRP", "NamePrism"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Method, y = Distance, fill = Method, color = Method)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Distance from Observed Demographics") +
  scale_fill_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  scale_color_grafify("kelly", name = "Method") +
  bw_clean()

population_combined <- population_plot / distance_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))

ggsave(file.path(figs_dir, "PPP_08_population.png"), population_plot, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 200)
ggsave(file.path(figs_dir, "PPP_08b_population_distance.png"), distance_plot, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 200)
ggsave(file.path(figs_dir, "PPP_population.png"), population_combined, width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 200)
```
